svg.title: National holidays of 2026
svg.desc: A strip calendar of 2026. National holidays: 1 and 12 January, 11 and 23 February, 20 March, 29 April, 3, 4 and 5 May, 20 July, 11 August, 21 and 23 September, 12 October, 3 and 23 November. Extra days off: 6 May (substitute) and 22 September (sandwiched). With weekends, they make long breaks in early May and late September.
